lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ce3Ag2Se6 crystallizes in the trigonal space group P-31m (No. 143), with a 11-atom unit cell and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag centers coordinated by three Se neighbors and Ce centers coordinated by eight Se neighbors, while Se sites appear in both 11- and 7-coordinate environments. The connectivity forms a single three-dimensional component, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Ce 8-vertex and Se 11-vertex polyhedra, as well as corner- and edge-sharing among Se polyhedra.
